models.name: WeatherNext 2 / WeatherNext Cyclones
models.note_en: Specialized AI weather models achieving SOTA cyclone track/intensity forecasts; code and weights open-sourced for research and operational use.
models.note_zh: 專用 AI 天氣模型，達最先進氣旋路徑／強度預報；程式碼與權重已開源供研究與作業使用。

models.name: Muse Spark 1.2
models.note_en: Coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1 with scaled coding compute and improved long-horizon developer workflows; powers the new Muse Code agent.
models.note_zh: Muse Spark 1.1 的編碼導向更新，擴大編碼訓練算力並改善長程開發工作流；驅動新 Muse Code 代理。

models.name: Shieldstral
models.note_en: 3B open multimodal safety classifier (Apache 2.0) that is policy-adaptive at inference and SOTA on multimodal moderation
models.note_zh: 30億參數開源多模態安全分類器（Apache 2.0），推理時可政策自適應，多模態審核達SOTA

models.name: Alpamayo 2 Super
models.note_en: ~34B open reasoning VLA model for AVs/robotaxis, now commercially available under OpenMDW-1.1
models.note_zh: 約340億參數開源自動駕駛推理VLA模型，現以OpenMDW-1.1授權開放商業使用

models.name: Alpamayo 2 Super
models.note_en: Frontier open reasoning model for robotaxis/AVs; commercial use under OpenMDW-1.1; leads LingoQA.
models.note_zh: 專攻 Robotaxi／自駕車的前沿開源推理模型；OpenMDW-1.1 商業授權；LingoQA 領先。

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max
models.note_en: 2.4T total / 95B active sparse MoE, 1M context, multimodal; API live, open weights next week.
models.note_zh: 總參數2.4T／啟動95B稀疏MoE、1M上下文、多模態；API已上線，開源權重下週釋出。

models.name: Inkling-Small
models.note_en: 276B total / 12B active MoE open-weights multimodal model matching or exceeding larger sibling on agentic coding and reasoning
models.note_zh: 276B 總參數／12B 活躍參數的開源 MoE 多模態模型，在代理編碼與推理上達到或超越更大同系列模型

models.name: Gemini Robotics 2
models.note_en: Vision-language-action model family for whole-body humanoid control, advanced dexterity and multi-robot collaboration (includes ER 2 and On-Device 2 variants)
models.note_zh: 視覺語言行動模型系列，支援人形機器人全身控制、進階靈巧操作與多機器人協作（含 ER 2 與 On-Device 2 變體）

models.name: Gemini Robotics ER 2
models.note_en: Embodied reasoning VLM for multi-step task planning, progress tracking, and multi-robot collaboration.
models.note_zh: 具身推理視覺語言模型，支援多步驟任務規劃、進度追蹤與多機器人協作。

models.name: Gemini Robotics On-Device 2
models.note_en: Lightweight on-device VLA that adapts to new robot embodiments with fewer than 200 examples in several hours.
models.note_zh: 輕量端側 VLA，能以少於 200 個範例在數小時內適配新機器人機體。

models.name: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0
models.note_en: Next-generation voice model with improved speech reasoning, 1.5–2× transcription accuracy vs prior SOTA, leading Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech score (82.9%) and τ-voice agentic bench (56.5%).
models.note_zh: 次世代語音模型，語音推理提升、轉錄準確率較先前 SOTA 提升 1.5–2 倍，Artificial Analysis 語音品質指數領先（82.9%），τ-voice 代理基準達 56.5%。

models.name: Lyria 3.5
models.note_en: Updated music-generation model with better vocals, lyrics, musicality and tempo/duration control; powers Google Flow Music.
models.note_zh: 更新音樂生成模型，改進人聲、歌詞、音樂性與節奏/時長控制；驅動 Google Flow Music。

models.name: Kimi K3
models.note_en: 2.8T MoE (~104B active) full open weights released; 1M context, native multimodal; largest open-weight frontier model to date under Kimi K3 License.
models.note_zh: 2.8 兆參數 MoE（約 104B 活躍）完整開源權重釋出；1M 上下文、原生多模態；迄今最大開放權重前沿模型，採 Kimi K3 License。

models.name: Kimi K3
models.note_en: Full open weights of 2.8T-parameter MoE model (~104B active) with 1M context and native multimodality released on Hugging Face under the Kimi K3 License.
models.note_zh: 在 Hugging Face 釋出 2.8 兆參數 MoE 模型（活躍約 104B）完整權重，含 1M 上下文與原生多模態，採用 Kimi K3 License。

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.note_en: Near-frontier performance approaching Claude Fable 5 at roughly half the price; new default on Claude Max and strongest model on Claude Pro.
models.note_zh: 性能接近 Claude Fable 5、價格約一半；成為 Claude Max 預設模型與 Claude Pro 最強選項。

models.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.note_en: Workhorse efficiency model with better coding, knowledge work and ~17% lower output-token usage than 3.5 Flash.
models.note_zh: 效率主力模型，程式碼與知識工作表現提升，輸出token用量較3.5 Flash約降17%。

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
models.note_en: Fastest 3.5-class model (350 tok/s) optimized for high-volume agentic and coding tasks.
models.note_zh: 3.5系列最快模型（350 tok/s），針對高量代理與程式碼任務優化。

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber
models.note_en: Lightweight cybersecurity specialist fine-tuned for vulnerability finding, validation and patching; limited pilot access.
models.note_zh: 輕量網路安全專用模型，微調用於漏洞發現、驗證與修補；限量試點存取。

models.name: Cosmos 3 Edge
models.note_en: 4B-parameter open omnimodel for edge physical AI; understands/generates text, image, video, sound and action; #1 on VANTAGE-Bench.
models.note_zh: 40億參數開源全模態模型，專為邊緣實體AI設計；能理解與生成文字、影像、影片、聲音與動作；VANTAGE-Bench排名第一。

models.name: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge
models.note_en: 4B-parameter open omnimodel for edge devices; understands/generates text, image, video, sound and action; #1 on VANTAGE-Bench in class.
models.note_zh: 40 億參數開源全模態模型，專為邊緣裝置優化；可理解與生成文字、影像、影片、聲音與動作；同參數級 VANTAGE-Bench 排名第一。

models.name: Inkling
models.note_en: First open-weights model from Thinking Machines Lab: 975B MoE (41B active), native multimodal (text/image/audio), up to 1M context, fine-tunable on Tinker.
models.note_zh: Thinking Machines Lab首款開源權重模型：975B MoE（活躍41B）、原生多模態（文字／圖像／音訊）、最高1M上下文，可在Tinker上微調。

models.name: Inkling
models.note_en: 975B total / 41B active parameters MoE multimodal model (text/image/audio) with 1M context window; first open-weights release from Thinking Machines Lab under Apache 2.0.
models.note_zh: 975B 總參數 / 41B 活躍參數 MoE 多模態模型（文字/圖像/音訊），具 100 萬 token 上下文；Thinking Machines Lab 首個 Apache 2.0 開放權重發布。
